title: Start times lack timezone and day on the slate; matchup uses nicknames that are ambiguous
steps: Read slate rows: "Lions @ Mavericks", "Bears @ Saints", "12:42 AM"
expected: Show ET and a day for same-day after-midnight games; full team names
actual: Many identical nicknames (Bulldogs, Tigers, Bears, Wildcats) in college sports; game page header says ET but slate does not. Tennis uses "@" for players.
